transcript:
Alex: The onboarding page is ready for review. Maya, please test the signup flow by Friday.
Maya: I will also check mobile layouts.
Alex: Great. We agreed to launch on Monday if the signup tests pass.

conversation.speaker: Alex
conversation.text: The onboarding page is ready for review. Maya, please test the signup flow by Friday.

conversation.speaker: Maya
conversation.text: I will also check mobile layouts.

conversation.speaker: Alex
conversation.text: Great. We agreed to launch on Monday if the signup tests pass.

conversation.speaker: Maya
conversation.text: I'll cover new accounts, expired invitations, and the case where someone tries to register twice.

conversation.speaker: Alex
conversation.text: Please check what happens if the confirmation email is delayed. The resend action should be easy to find.

conversation.speaker: Maya
conversation.text: I'll test on a narrow viewport as well. The keyboard shouldn't hide the submit button.

conversation.speaker: Alex
conversation.text: Let's track blockers separately from cosmetic issues so we can make a clear launch decision.

conversation.speaker: Maya
conversation.text: I'll share a checklist and screenshots on Friday afternoon. Any signup blocker goes to you right away.

conversation.speaker: Alex
conversation.text: I'll review the checklist before launch. If signup is blocked, we'll postpone and keep the current page live.

conversation.speaker: Maya
conversation.text: Sounds good. I'll add the email and mobile checks to the checklist now.

summary.title: Onboarding launch planning
summary.summary: The onboarding page is ready for review. Maya will test signup and check mobile layouts. The launch is planned for Monday if signup tests pass.
keyPoints: Onboarding page is ready for review
Mobile layouts need a final check
decisions: Launch on Monday if signup tests pass
